record.paper_title: On two open problems about embedding of modules in free modules
record.original_question: For a ring R, call R a left CF ring when each cyclic module over R on the left side can be injected into some free left R-module. Must every left CF ring be left artinian?

evidence.quote: Is a left CF ring left artinian?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $R$ be an associative ring with identity. Call $R$ a **left CF ring** if every cyclic left $R$-module embeds (as a left $R$-module) into some free left $R$-module. Recall that $R$ is **left artinian** if it satisfies the descending chain condition on left ideals.

Question: Must every left CF ring be left artinian?
artifact.category_tag: CF ring conjecture (module embeddings in free modules)
artifact.status_search_result: The CF conjecture (every left CF ring is left artinian), formulated by Faith, remains an open problem in ring theory. Various partial results are known (e.g., a left CF ring is left artinian iff it is von Neumann regular modulo its left singular ideal; the CF conjecture implies the FGF conjecture), but no full solution has been published as of recent literature.

status_evidence.title: The FGF conjecture and the singular ideal of a ring
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the still-open CF and FGF conjectures and partial reductions involving the singular ideal.
status_evidence.claim: The CF conjecture is treated as an open problem with partial results.

status_evidence.title: Hypersimple rings and modules (arXiv:2302.03974)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work referencing the CF/FGF problems on embedding cyclic/finitely generated modules into free modules.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature still references the CF problem as open.
